TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH · INSTITUTIONAL EDUCATION

From complex omics data to meaningful biological insights.

Arkhe Multiomics is a research and education platform connecting computational analysis, scientific consulting, and specialized training in single-cell, spatial, and integrated multiomics.

TRANSLATIONAL RESEARCH

Bioinformatics consulting

Specialized computational analysis, reproducible workflows, and scientific support tailored to your research questions, study design, and available datasets.

01

Bioinformatics analysis

End-to-end and targeted analyses, from quality control and preprocessing to statistical modeling, visualization, and biological interpretation.

02

Pipelines & workflows

Development, adaptation, evaluation, and documentation of reproducible computational workflows.

03

Scientific consulting

Study planning, analytical strategy, method selection, troubleshooting, and collaborative computational research.

04

Research interpretation

Support in connecting quantitative results with biological hypotheses and scientific communication.

ARKHE INSTITUTIONAL

Institutional Partnerships

Specialized multiomics education for academic program coordinators, graduate schools, and continuing education. Two ways to bring Arkhe courses to your institution.

01 · FULLY MANAGED

Immersive Courses →

Asynchronous courses hosted on Arkhe's platform, with access licenses, technical and academic support, annual maintenance, and grade management.

02 · SELF-MANAGED

Specialized Course Content →

Specialized educational content for your institution's learning environment. Your team manages course delivery, learner support, assessments, and administration.

Course content available in Spanish.

Subject areas: scRNA-seq · scATAC-seq · Multiomics integration · Spatial transcriptomics

TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

Omics technologies

Single-cell RNA-seq

Cell populations, differential expression, annotation, and transcriptional heterogeneity.

Single-cell ATAC-seq

Chromatin accessibility, regulatory elements, and motif analysis.

Spatial transcriptomics

Spatial domains, tissue organization, and cell-type mapping.

Multiomics integration

Integrated RNA, chromatin accessibility, and spatial analyses.

Bulk RNA-seq

Quantification, differential expression, and functional interpretation.

Project scope and deliverables are defined according to scientific questions, experimental design, and available data.

ABOUT ARKHE

Research-driven. Methodologically rigorous.

Founded by Cynthia S. Cardinault, PhD

Arkhe Multiomics is a scientist-led initiative grounded in computational biology, transcriptomics, epigenomics, and integrative analysis. We emphasize reproducibility, biologically meaningful interpretation, and accessible scientific education.
